name: Dusupay African Payments API
description: Dusupay is an African payments platform that enables merchants to collect and disburse funds via mobile money, bank transfers, and card payments across 15+ African countries. It supports collections (inbound payments), payouts/disbursements (outbound transfers), and provides utility endpoints for balance inquiries, payment provider listings, and transaction verification.
